simWorld.title: Farm Simulation World (விவசாய அனுபவ உலகம்)
simWorld.subtitle: Interactive, physics-grounded agricultural decision simulator. Test climate scenarios, smart irrigation and multi-season crop rotations before spending money in the field.
simWorld.card1Desc: Simulate rising temperatures (+1°C to +6°C), delayed monsoons, and extreme dry spells with real-time foliage and soil reactions.
simWorld.card2Desc: 3D visual soil cross-section with roots, wetting bulbs, and percolation losses comparing Drip, Sprinkler, and Traditional Flood.
simWorld.card3Desc: Plan 3-4 crop cycles. Watch animated soil organic carbon accumulation, legume nitrogen fixation, and pest breaks.
simWorld.card4Desc: Simulate monsoon deluge and prolonged drought. Test raised beds, drainage trenches, and emergency mulching.
simWorld.card5Desc: Side-by-side survival curves for Paddy, Millets, Groundnut and Cotton under heat, drought, and waterlogging.
simWorld.card6Desc: Step-by-step month journey from land preparation, basal fertilization, and weather shocks to harvest economics.
simWorld.nasaBaselineUsed: Calibrated with authentic NASA POWER & SMAP agroclimatology baseline for your coordinates.

simClimate.title: Climate Change & Crop Resilience Simulator
simClimate.subtitle: Interactively adjust temperature, seasonal rainfall, and dry spell duration to understand real-time impacts on your crops and soil.
simClimate.drySpellExplanation: Consecutive days without rainfall (accelerates soil moisture evaporation and moisture stress)
simClimate.cropConsequence: 3. What Could Happen to Your Crop?
simClimate.observedDesc: NASA POWER 1981-2025 daily climatology and NASA GPM IMERG satellite precipitation establish the true historical baseline for your farmland coordinates.
simClimate.derivedDesc: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith equation computes daily reference crop evapotranspiration (ET₀) combining temperature, solar insolation, and air humidity.
simClimate.hypotheticalDesc: The temperature change (+°C), rainfall change (%), and dry spell days selected via sliders are hypothetical test scenarios, not current NASA forecasts.
simClimate.modelDesc: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University crop temperature tolerance thresholds and yield response curves calculate the projected harvest penalty.

soilMoisturePage.title: NASA SMAP Soil Moisture Monitoring
soilMoisturePage.subtitle: Satellite microwave observations of Surface (0-5cm) and Root-Zone (0-100cm) soil moisture.
soilMoisturePage.chartDesc: NASA SMAP Enhanced Surface (0-5cm) vs Root-Zone (0-100cm) Volumetric %
soilMoisturePage.sciNoteDesc: SMAP satellite measurements are microwave radiometer readings of physical soil moisture. They do not represent chemical laboratory soil fertility or pH tests.
soilMoisturePage.tnauTitle: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) Irrigation Guidance:
soilMoisturePage.point1: When surface soil moisture drops below 14%, permanent wilting point begins. Immediate irrigation is recommended.
soilMoisturePage.point2: For paddy cultivation, adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) rather than continuous submergence to save up to 30% irrigation water.
soilMoisturePage.point3: Millets (Ragi, Kambu) thrive even in low 15-18% soil moisture conditions.

vegetationPage.title: Crop Growth & Vegetation Health Monitoring
vegetationPage.subtitle: Satellite optical reflectance tracking of NDVI and EVI vegetative growth vigour.
vegetationPage.chartDesc: NASA MODIS MOD13Q1 (250m) & HLS 30m Optical Chlorophyll Reflection
vegetationPage.sciNoteDesc: NDVI and EVI measure photosynthetic canopy density and vegetative vigor. They do not directly measure final grain or harvest yield.
vegetationPage.faqBody: An NDVI value below 0.20 indicates bare soil, fallow land, or completed harvest. Between 0.40 and 0.60 indicates active vegetative growth. Above 0.60 indicates a dense, healthy canopy. It reflects current crop vegetative vigor, not guaranteed harvest yield.

healthScorePage.title: Farm Health Score & Environmental Index
healthScorePage.subtitle: A transparent composite index synthesising 4 NASA Earth science environmental indicators.
healthScorePage.transparencyBody: This score is a calculated composite indicator created by Nilam Pesum from NASA environmental observations. It is not an official NASA rating or a laboratory soil chemical analysis.
